arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent animation sprite correction
Input images: Image 1 is the current approved polished SMDATE6 021 sprite and is the edit target. Image 2 is the approved SMDATE6 018 mango-design consistency anchor. Image 3 shows that same mango at the mouth in corrected frame 020. Image 4 is the original 021 action and component-boundary guide.
Primary request: Replace only the strange green leafy food bundle at the mermaid's mouth with the same single ripe mango established in Images 2 and 3, now held close in both hands as she leans farther forward and eats it.
Mango continuity: match the compact oval identity, approximate scale, warm golden yellow-orange body, restrained red blush on the outer right side, small muted green top patch, tiny short stem at the right end, highlight treatment, and bold black outline. The yellow-orange left end contacts her open eating mouth naturally. A small fresh bite indentation at the mouth contact is acceptable, but keep it clearly the same mango. NO leaves, NO leafy bundle, NO second fruit, NO sliced fruit.
Style/medium: match the established polished late-1990s cartoon sprite, bold clean black outline, smooth cel shading and highlights.
Constraints: Change only the food object and the minimum finger and mouth contact needed for a natural bite. Preserve pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible Image 1's approved mermaid identity, both fully closed eyes, non-smiling eating mouth with teeth, stronger forward lean, head angle, face, hair, cyan headband, green swimsuit, exposed bellybutton and torso, tail/waterline, both arm positions, both hands, crop, proportions, line weight, colors, and genuine transparent RGBA background. Do not turn the bite into a smile. No scenery, no text, no watermark, no extra objects.
